## Description {#details}

<p>Statepoint instruction in deopt parameters contains values which are meaningful to the runtime and should be able to be read at the moment the call returns.</p>


<p>So we can say that we need to encode the fact that these values are "late read" by runtime. If we could express this notion for register allocator it would produce the right form for us. The need to fixup (i.e this pass) is specifically handling the fact that we cannot describe such a late read for the register allocator. <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/register">Register</a> allocator may put the value on a register clobbered by the call. This pass forces the spill of such registers and replaces corresponding statepoint operands to added spill slots.</p>
